findings.title: Hall-bath insert nailers stand 81-84.5 in above the floor; stock 60x30 inserts flange at 71-76.5 in

evidence.measured: Both furred nailers (added after round 1 for I2-010/E9) are 3.5 in bands at 81 in above the finished floor (checks.json integrity.wall_backing_ref: 'BK-S-N3-TUB-NAILER ... 3.5" of 2x4 at 81" above the floor'), i.e. 81-84.5 in, sized to the type's placeholder head: FX-TUBSHOWER-60 height = ft(7) ('not a product dimension', fixture_types_wc.py comment). FX-TUBSHOWER-60-DIVERTED has no insert product_ref (only the Delta trim). Listed 60x30 inserts: Sterling Ensemble 60x30 kit 71 in (Lowe's), 72.5 in and 76.5 in (USSupply/Amazon/Studio41), Sterling Medley set 73-74.25 in.
evidence.expected: A top flange nailer at the delivered insert's flange line, about 71-76.5 in for stock units. A flange at 76 in lands 4.5 in below the nailer's bottom edge and floats off the furred plane the nailer exists to give it.
evidence.method: checks.json integrity.wall_backing_ref (baseline); Python probe SCRATCH/I2/p8-style: read WallBacking BK-S-N3-TUB-NAILER elevation/height from plan/backing_wet.py; web: Sterling Ensemble 60x30 listings (Lowes 1000618545, Ferguson 4705870, ussupply 1931716).

findings.source: plan/backing_wet.py comment 'confirm the flange line on the delivered unit'; listings above (class heights, not a spec sheet)
findings.proposed_fix: Name the 60x30 insert (product row with published height and flange line), then author the nailers at that flange: e.g. 2x4 at ~68-72 in plus the vertical returns. Until then print 'nailer top at delivered flange +/- 2 in' on S-601.

findings.title: TOTO floor bowls: model puts the tank back on the finished wall; TOTO's own drawing stands it 3/4 in (Drake 13/16 in) off

evidence.measured: floor_wc_ports puts the flange at (depth/2 - 12 in) from the footprint centre, so with the footprint back on the wall the flange is 12.00 in from the wall and the TANK BACK is at 0 in. Resolved: FX-M-BATH2-WC flange 12.01 in off clear face, FX-S-BATH1-WC 12.00, FX-S-SUITEBATH-WC 12.34, FX-B-BATH-WC/FX-A-STUBATH-WC 11.94. Footprint back = finish face in all five.
evidence.expected: TOTO SS-02072 (Aquia IV CST446CEMGN) and SS-01809 (Carlyle II): finished wall to tank back 3/4 in [18-20 mm] with the flange at 12 in; SS-02049 (Drake CST776CEF(R)(G)): 13/16 in [20 mm]. All three sheets say 'to maintain adequate wall gap ... mount the floor flange at a nominal 12 in rough-in'. So the bowl front stands 0.75-0.81 in farther into the room than modelled and the room's front clearance and any peer margin shrinks by that. Re-measured margins stay positive: BATH2 WC zone to FX-M-BATH2-SINK 6.18 -> 5.43 in; STUBATH WC zone to FX-A-STUBATH-SH 2.06 -> 1.25 in; STUBATH lav 0.62 in unchanged (lateral).
evidence.method: Downloaded SS-02072, SS-01809, SS-02049 from totousa.com/filemanager_uploads/product_assets/SpecSheet and read the DIMENSIONS drawing (page 2). Probe SCRATCH/I2/p5.py: shift each WC's required ClearanceZone toward the front by the gap and re-measure distance to peer footprints.

findings.proposed_fix: Put the 3/4 in gap into the bowl's footprint offset (shift each WC 0.75 in toward the room, keep the flange where it is: change floor_wc_ports to depth/2 - 12 + gap and move the 5 fixtures by +gap along their front), then re-run the five WC drains. Pure model fidelity: no print dimension changes except footprint.

TOTO sheets (suggested dimensions, 'Supply as Req'd'): Carlyle II 6 in off centreline, 8 in AFF (matches); Aquia IV 5 7/8 in off centreline, 4 3/4 in AFF (port 3.25 in high); Drake 4 5/16 in off centreline, 7 1/2 in AFF. Max protrusion with 90 degree stop 3 1/8 in.
evidence.expected: Per-type stations from the sheets: Aquia 4 3/4 in AFF / 5 7/8 in left; Drake 7 1/2 / 4 5/16. The hall-bath cold stop then needs the stop within about 4.6 in of the pipe end it has now (a flex line, not a clash) but the stub height is 3 in lower than the allowance.
evidence.method: Read the DIMENSIONS drawings of SS-02072 (Aquia) and SS-02049 (Drake) page 2 at 260 dpi (SCRATCH/I2/dl/aqz-2.png, drz-2.png); checks.json mep.fixture_port_connection.

findings.proposed_fix: Give floor_wc_ports a per-type (left, height) argument from the sheets and correct the comment; retarget PR-S-BATH1-WC-CW / PR-S-SUITE-WC-CW / PR-B-BATH-WC-CW / PR-A-STUBATH-WC-CW stubs to them.
